stem: If \(\frac{3}{x - 1} = \frac{5}{x + 3}\), what is the value of \(x\)?

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is the result of a sign slip, writing \(9 + 5 = -2x\) instead of \(9 + 5 = 2x\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the result of subtracting 5 from 9 instead of adding when moving \(-5\) across the equation.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the reciprocal of the solution.

verify:
x = symbols('x')
sol = solve(Eq(3/(x - 1), 5/(x + 3)), x)
assert sol == [7]
ans = 7
assert value(choices[answer]) == ans
assert all(value(choices[k]) != ans for k in choices if k != answer)
